title: 纳尔·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 橙色绒毛、巨大的双耳与修长尾巴，组成小型史前约德尔外形。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Gnar is a small prehistoric yordle with orange fur, very large pointed ears, bright blue eyes, a long expressive tail, and a compact animal-like body. Preserve his species-specific scale and primitive opaque garment wrap rather than making him an adult human or an oversized infant mascot. His recognizable bone-like boomerang hangs quietly from one hand, never thrown or swung.
art_direction.scene: An expansive horizontal arrangement inside the square for the complete character silhouette, concentrated facial drawing and loose peripheral marks. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: burnt orange, sky blue, bone ivory, slate; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
